meta.title: L1 price per line is the lowest unit price
gaps: The setup provides two vendors and one line item, not three vendors and five lines.
The available read-back fields do not expose L1 unit prices or line totals, so the lowest price and corresponding total cannot be asserted.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds.
